similar.text: Nightly ORDB backups are kept for two weeks.
Trackbox telematics units ping their position every half minute while the vehicle is moving.
Gatekeeper gives each API key a budget of 600 calls a minute.
Pathly bills by the number of matrix cells requested.
The rate tables get reloaded at 05:00 UTC on Mondays.
A Sev1 needs an incident commander from the SRE roster within a quarter of an hour.
Helpdeskly has sixty agent seats.
Textline delivery receipts come back through a webhook inside a minute.
Roughly 4,200 customer accounts are active on the Beacon portal.
Redkite reports go to the Security team and the VP of Engineering.
Mailpost emails are DKIM-signed with keys that rotate annually.
Telemetry rows are kept for 90 days in raw form.
ORDB nightly snapshots are retained for 30 days.
TRKDB is a twelve-node Cassandra cluster owned by the Routing team.
Gatekeeper tokens last 90 minutes.
The Cumulus enterprise agreement renews on 2028-09-01.
The ShipLink contract renews each July.
Routewise re-plans open routes every 30 minutes during the delivery window.
Haul works offline for up to 12 hours.
Postmortem documents are due within 10 business days of a Sev1 or Sev2.
Brightdesk placements are limited to 18 months.
The Security team is led by Nina Castellano and has 6 members.
Redkite runs the penetration test every September.
Staging is refreshed from anonymised production data on the second Sunday of each month.
Gatekeeper caps each API key at 300 requests per minute.
Production deployments need just one approval from the owning team.
Database credentials in the vault are rotated every 180 days.
Access is recertified once a year.
Deletion requests have a 45-day deadline.
Managers can approve purchases up to 2,000 EUR.
The MapForge contract covers 30 million geocoding calls a year.
Haul can run offline for only four hours.
Routewise is licensed per depot and the renewal fee is due in March.
The Kafka cluster's broker hardware was bought from a Dutch reseller.
Marta Keller has a weekly one-to-one with the CFO on Thursdays.
Alertly phone calls are recorded for quality purposes.
The Haul app icon was redesigned in the spring of 2025.
Dmitri Ocampo is presenting the SRE roadmap at the January all-hands.
The Snowflake warehouse in REPWH has a separate dev account in the Frankfurt region.
The Cumulus archive bucket has object versioning turned on.
